result: Agent TUI bridge: authentic terminal renderer stream + controls. createAgentTuiBridge adapts the platform-neutral PtyHandle to the renderer; commands route through the module-level store (fail closed when unbound); Interrupt control activates only when attached at the exact current run generation (store.generation + acceptsOutput gate). No static terminal text exists; renderer is a live PTY stream. Same Pi session + Attachment in Mission Canvas and Agent TUI.
